title: Treasure Hunt (bug hunt)
body:
Goal: steer an explorer to a spinning star, and fix a sprite that never reacts. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Open your explorer project from Exercise 3.1 (File > Load from your computer).
  2. Click Choose a Sprite and add a Star. Give the Star the script "Star" below.
  3. Click your explorer sprite. Add Sam's script below exactly, bug and all.
  4. Click the green flag and steer the explorer onto the star with the arrow keys. What happens? Why?
  5. Fix Sam's script (remember the goalkeeper: keep checking!). Test again.
  6. Save as treasure-hunt.

The scripts in words

Star sprite:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: 180 y: 120
  • forever:
    • turn right 5 degrees

Explorer sprite (Sam's version, with a bug), plus the four arrow-key scripts from 3.1:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: -180 y: -120
  • if touching Star? then
    • say "Treasure found!" for 2 seconds
    • go to x: -180 y: -120

Expected behavior

After your fix: the star waits in the top-right corner, spinning. You steer the explorer with the arrow keys. Every time the explorer touches the star, it says "Treasure found!" for 2 seconds and jumps back to the bottom-left start, ready to play again.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Build the explorer script and run it. Does it ever say "Treasure found!"? Think about when the question touching Star? is asked. Is it asked once, or many times?

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: The explorer asks the question one time at the very start, before you can move. Think of a goalkeeper who watches the goal all game long. Look in the Control category for a block that keeps something running.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Right now the question is asked only once. Your explorer needs to keep checking, over and over, while you steer. Find the loop that never stops in Control, and think about which blocks belong inside it. Then test again and steer onto the star.
